🏈 Gridiron Gang (2006) — Drama / Sports
A group of young men with troubled pasts gets a chance to change their lives through football. Sean Porter creates a football team inside a juvenile detention center, teaching them that discipline, teamwork, and determination can help them become more than the mistakes they’ve made.
As the team faces challenges on and off the field, the players begin to build trust, overcome rivalries, and discover a sense of purpose. What starts as a simple football program becomes a second chance for young people who thought their future was already decided.
The movie explores teamwork, redemption, discipline, friendship, second chances, and personal growth.
